text: A body of mass 12kg is released from a height of 50m. What is its total mechanical energy just before it hits the ground? [Take \(g = 10\)m/s²]
explanation:
Total mechanical energy is conserved during free fall.

At the top it is all potential: \(PE = mgh = 12 \times 10 \times 50 = 6000\)J

Just before landing this has all become kinetic energy, so the total is still 6000J.
